Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $95 in July?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (7% odds) on crude reach $95. Closes in 2d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $75 in July?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (6% odds) on crude drop below $75. Closes in 2d. A move this low would ease diesel and nitrogen input cost pressure heading into side-dress and summer ops.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $70 in July?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (1% odds) on crude drop below $70. Closes in 2d. A move this low would ease diesel and nitrogen input cost pressure heading into side-dress and summer ops.

Economy & Markets.title: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 86% odds of a rate cut. Lower rates reduce operating loan and land interest carrying cost -- historically supportive of commodity prices via weaker dollar.

Economy & Markets.title: Fed rate hike in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 75% odds of a rate hike. Tighter policy strengthens the dollar and pressures grain export competitiveness.
